mcqs.question: What does the review call the most effective interventions for work-related asthma?

options.A: Early diagnosis and complete removal of the causative exposure
options.B: Continued exposure with a reliever inhaler only
options.D: Delaying diagnosis until disability is fixed

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Early diagnosis and complete removal of the causative exposure
mcqs.explanation: Early diagnosis and complete removal of exposure are the most effective interventions for prevention and treatment.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Early diagnosis and complete removal of exposure to the causative agent are the most effective interventions

mcqs.question: What latency does the review describe for sensitizer-induced disease?

options.A: Symptoms months or years after exposure
options.D: Symptoms only after retirement in every case
options.E: A latency of minutes is the definition given

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Symptoms months or years after exposure
mcqs.explanation: The latency period is symptoms occurring months or years after exposure. Earlier onset is associated with higher exposure.

sourceRefs.excerpt: symptoms occurring months or years after exposure

mcqs.question: What are high-molecular-weight occupational agents in this review?

options.A: Proteins of animal or vegetable origin
options.D: Only isocyanates, which the same sentence places with low-molecular-weight haptens

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Proteins of animal or vegetable origin
mcqs.explanation: High-molecular-weight agents consist of proteins of animal or vegetable origin.

sourceRefs.excerpt: High-molecular-weight agents consist of proteins of animal or vegetable origin.

mcqs.question: How does the review describe serial peak-flow measurements?

options.A: The simplest and least expensive method to assess response to inhaled agents or the workplace
options.D: A replacement for removal from exposure

mcqs.correctAnswerText: The simplest and least expensive method to assess response to inhaled agents or the workplace
mcqs.explanation: Serial PEF is the simplest and least expensive method to assess response to inhaled agents or work conditions.

sourceRefs.excerpt: serial PEF measurements provide the simplest and least expensive method

mcqs.question: Which category, other than sensitizer-induced occupational asthma, is named in the review?

options.C: Exercise asthma in athletes with no workplace

mcqs.explanation: Work-exacerbated asthma is named alongside occupational asthma.
